---
title: "Temporal coverage"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

One cell is one participant-variable day (UTC). Colour shows observed five-minute
buckets (0–288), regardless of observations per bucket. Rows use the same subject order across all panels; a thin bar beside each panel shows nationality. `sleep` and `sleeprate` are excluded.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
triggerR <- new.env()
source("R/read_data.R", local = triggerR)
if (!exists("trigger_daily")) trigger_daily <- triggerR$read_trigger_daily()
if (!exists("active_accounts")) active_accounts <- triggerR$read_trigger_active_accounts()

coverage <- trigger_daily %>%
  filter(variable != "sleeprate", statistic == "mean") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  transmute(origin, userId, date, variable,
            buckets = sum(jsonlite::fromJSON(`5min_profile`)),
            recorded = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

windows <- coverage %>%
  group_by(userId) %>%
  summarise(first = min(date), last = max(date), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(select(active_accounts, userId, nationality), by = "userId", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  mutate(nationality = replace_na(na_if(nationality, ""), "Unknown")) %>%
  arrange(nationality, userId) %>%
  mutate(subject = row_number())

coverage <- windows %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(userId, subject, date = seq.Date(first, last, by = "day")) %>%
  crossing(distinct(coverage, origin, variable)) %>%
  left_join(coverage, by = c("userId", "date", "origin", "variable"), relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
  mutate(buckets = if_else(is.na(recorded), 0, buckets)) %>%
  select(origin, subject, date, variable, buckets)
```

White = no recorded buckets inside the subject's first-to-last date across all
sources; grey background = outside that inferred window. The inferred window
is not an enrolment or confirmed device-use period. Missing source-days inside it are shown as zero recorded coverage.
Profiles are counted once using the `mean` row, not summed across statistics.

Nationality comes from `active_accounts`; unavailable values are labelled
`Unknown`. Rows are ordered by nationality, without displaying subject IDs.

```{r}
p_nat <- ggplot(windows, aes(1, subject, fill = nationality)) +
  geom_tile(width = 1, height = 1) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(nrow(windows) + 0.5, 0.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Nationality") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

p_cov <- ggplot(coverage, aes(date, subject, fill = buckets)) +
  geom_tile(width = 1, height = 1) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(nrow(windows) + 0.5, 0.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "6 months", date_labels = "%Y-%m", expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#176B9B", limits = c(0, 288),
                      breaks = c(0, 72, 144, 216, 288)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Five-minute buckets per day") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = NA),
        panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

panels <- coverage %>%
  distinct(source = origin, measure = variable) %>%
  arrange(source, measure) %>%
  purrr::pmap(function(source, measure) {
    p_var <- (p_cov + filter(coverage, origin == source, variable == measure)) + labs(title = measure)
    (p_nat | p_var) + plot_layout(widths = c(0.015, 1))
  })

p <- wrap_plots(panels, ncol = 3, guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 18
#| fig-height: 24

p
```

## Overall coverage

For each subject-day, average the bucket counts within each source, then average
across sources with equal weight. Missing source-days inside the inferred window
contribute zero. This score ranges from 0 to 288; it is not a count of simultaneous
buckets across sources or a measure of data quality.

```{r}
coverage_sum <- coverage %>%
  group_by(subject, date, origin) %>%
  summarise(buckets = mean(buckets), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(subject, date) %>%
  summarise(buckets = mean(buckets), .groups = "drop")

p_sum <- (p_cov + coverage_sum) + labs(fill = "Mean buckets (equal source weights)")
p_sum <- (p_nat | p_sum) + plot_layout(widths = c(0.015, 1), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
